releaseNotes:
🚀 5.2 Update!

- 📊 Ring gauges for RAM, storage and battery
- 🔄 Live device stats and battery temperature
- 🔍 Search bar to find tweaks fast
- ⭐ Favorites: long-press a tweak to pin it
- 🎯 New Favorites and Active filters
- 🎨 Compact cards with category colors
- ↩️ Undo after applying a tweak
- 📳 Haptic feedback on actions
- 🛠️ Shizuku hint with a Fix button
- 🌗 Improved Material 3 theme
